releases.name: M8 image asset management (beta)
releases.summary: Ship M8 image asset management as a beta pre-release: portable asset copying, inlined rendering and export, a visible missing-asset state, drag/drop import and image-local controls, plus the two blocking defects a pre-release slop-ferret sweep verified — startup no longer fails on an unreadable preference store, and image resolution is pinned on every render surface.
